newsitem.title: USA: Nationwide Financial IPO price range boosted.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide Financial IPO price range boosted.

text.p: The price to invest in the $480 million initial public offering of Nationwide Financial Services Inc has been raised, lead underwriter Credit Suisse First Boston said on Wednesday.
The shares are due to begin trading tomorrow.

The price for the 20.5 million shares was lifted to between $23 and $24 a share, up from an earlier range of $21 to $23 each. The rise in the range means Nationwide, a provider of long-term savings and retirement products, could scoop up an extra $30 million from the IPO.
The offering is the largest deal due this week and the strong demand reflects the recent bias in the IPO market towards larger companies with longer operating histories and higher liquidity.
Earlier today, Nationwide sold $300 million worth in debt.
